On this page

Your WordPress admin (Sikshya) ​

Open WordPress admin → Sikshya (your site may show a custom name from branding). You get one full-screen app with a sidebar. The labels below match what the plugin ships in code—if you don’t see an item, your user role may not have access (students don’t see most of this).

Free vs Pro: Some links show a small Upgrade or Off badge in the sidebar (same colors as in the product). That means the feature needs Sikshya Pro, the right plan, and the Add-on switched on under Addons.

Sidebar groups (simple map) ​

Dashboard ​

Your home inside Sikshya—stats and shortcuts. Start here after Quick start.

Course (group) ​

ItemWhat it’s forDocumentation
CoursesList and open the course builderCourses & curriculum
CategoriesCourse categoriesCourses & curriculum
Content libraryLessons, quizzes, assignments, chapters, questions in one placeCourses & curriculum
Learning rulesDrip & prerequisites ProEnrollment & access, Pro add-ons
ReviewsCourse reviews ProPro add-ons
Discussions & Q&AIn-course Q&A ProPro add-ons
Course staffMulti-instructor ProPro add-ons

People (group) ​

ItemWhat it’s forDocumentation
Students & InstructorsUser management for your academyLearners, roles & progress
EnrollmentsWho is in which courseEnrollment & access

Certificates ​

Templates and issued certificates together. See Courses & curriculum and Pro add-ons for the advanced certificate builder.

Grading & submissions (group) ​

Assignment marking and Gradebook (Pro). See Pro add-ons.

Reports ​

High-level reports. See Learners and Pro add-ons for advanced exports.

Commerce (group) ​

ItemNotes
SalesOrders and payments together
CouponsDiscount codes (free core; advanced rules are Pro)
SubscriptionsPro add-on
MarketplacePro (Scale tier)

Details: Payments, Enrollment & access.

Integrations ​

Webhooks, API keys, and related automation (Pro / Scale). Pro add-ons.

Email ​

Email delivery settings and templates. Email & notifications.

Branding ​

Logos, colors, and labels (Pro options may apply). Pro add-ons.

Addons ​

Turn Pro features on or off per site. Pro add-ons.

License ​

Paste and activate Sikshya Pro. Installation.

Settings ​

All the tabs built in Settings (general, courses, payments, email, permalinks, …). Use Payments, Email, and Enrollment & access for the chapters that match what you’re changing.

Tools ​

Sample data import and maintenance. Quick start.

Setup Wizard stays registered under Sikshya for access checks, but the submenu link is hidden—the wizard still appears when the plugin prompts you after activation.

Next step ​

  • New site: Quick start, then Courses → Add.
  • Selling: Payments.
  • Upgrading: Get Sikshya Pro.
